# Provenance

This directory contains generated FOI JSON and HTML outputs. Structural inventories that opt into all_branch_foilers inspect every validated parameter of every recognized template. Other FOIs select or separately label the Scripture branches required by their own question.
This file was generated by MAM-basics/py/foi/foi_finals.py.
Payload files in this directory remain in their native data format, so provenance is recorded here rather than inside each file.
